name: kettlebell lunge with twist
description: Lunge forward while holding a kettlebell at your chest and rotate over the front leg. Trains legs and trunk rotation together.
instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell at chest height with both hands.
Step forward into a lunge, front knee over your ankle.
Rotate your torso toward the front leg, keeping hips square.
Turn back to center and push off the front foot to return.
